entities.summary: Itsuki Asai is a former baseball player from Japan. Asai played in the Nippon baseball league. He initially played in the Pioneer League, before moving on to the Hiroshima Toyo Carp in the Central League. At times, he played as a pinch hitter. Itsuki Asai was a athletes & competitors from Toyama (b. 1971-12-14, Toyama). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
